description: Fetches and searches existing YouTube captions, publisher-linked podcast transcripts and local SRT, VTT or JSON files, returning timestamped passages and source links. Uses a local stdio connector with the hosted service at https://media-transcript.remotify.run. Does not transcribe audio.
